item.text: The views place the hub on the positive X face. I’ve built a first model; the comparison shows that the plate needs a cam-shaped, faceted perimeter. You can follow the model in the [AgentCAD viewer](http://127.0.0.1:8770/#part.FCStd).

arguments.code:
import math
# Sampled cam outline in the plane normal to the shaft.
screen = [(29,204),(28,193),(29,181),(34,163),(42,142),(51,119),(61,97),(73,78),(85,62),(99,49),(114,39),(128,32),(142,28),(155,26.5),(168,27),(178,29),(184,33),(189,39),(192,47),(192,58),(191,70),(187,85),(182,101),(176,117),(168,133),(159,147),(150,160),(140,172),(129,182),(117,190),(104,198),(91,203),(77,207),(63,210),(51,212),(41,212),(34,209)]
pts=[]
for u,v in screen:
    y=-(u-113)/math.sqrt(2)
    z=y/2-(v-119)*math.sqrt(6)/4
    pts.append((y,z))
# Resample the continuous outline to regular perimeter facets.
wire=cq.Workplane('YZ').spline(pts, periodic=True).close().val()
edge=wire.Edges()[0]
outline=[]
for i in range(72):
    p=edge.positionAt(i/72)
    outline.append((p.y,p.z))
result=cq.Workplane('YZ').polyline(outline).close().extrude(21)
result=result.union(cq.Workplane('YZ',origin=(21,0,0)).circle(19).extrude(8))
result=result.cut(cq.Workplane('YZ',origin=(-1,0,0)).circle(7.5).extrude(32))
result=result.cut(cq.Workplane('YZ',origin=(-1,25,0)).circle(2).extrude(23))
# Shaft keyway at the upper edge of the bore.
result=result.cut(cq.Workplane('YZ',origin=(-1,0,7.5)).rect(5,4).extrude(32))
arguments.label: Faceted cam outline and keyed bore
